description.en: EIDOS — Evolving Identity & Development Operating System. An experience-driven state engine for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: EIDOS（Evolving Identity & Development Operating System）：让 AI 拥有可持久、可演化、可追溯内部状态的经历驱动引擎。
经历驱动的长期状态引擎：每条对话被记录为可核验的经历，情绪（PAD）、关系（信任）、学习（结论与建议）、人格（Trait 与影响实例池）随之演化，行为指导回注下一轮对话。全部变化可追溯、可审计、可重放。
description.en: Experience-driven state engine: each conversation turn becomes a verified experience; emotion (PAD), relationships (trust), learning (conclusions/suggestions) and personality (traits + influence pool) evolve from it, and behavior guidance is injected into the next turn. Fully auditable and replayable.
